products.name: EsoGuard Esophageal DNA Test (with EsoCheck Device)
products.description: A non-invasive, next-generation sequencing DNA assay performed on esophageal cells collected using the EsoCheck swallowable balloon capsule catheter, designed for early detection of esophageal precancer and cancer in at-risk GERD patients. The test is processed in a CLIA-certified laboratory and delivered as a diagnostic service to healthcare providers and patients.

products.name: Veris Cancer Care Platform (Digital Cancer Care Platform)
products.description: A comprehensive digital health platform for oncology practices and hospitals, providing remote physiological data collection, symptom reporting, telehealth, and EHR integration, delivered as a software-as-a-service subscription with connected health devices (VerisBox) for continuous patient monitoring during cancer treatment and survivorship.

products.name: PortIO Implantable Intraosseous Vascular Access Device
products.description: A novel, implantable medical device under development for long-term intraosseous vascular access, enabling infusion of fluids and medications directly into the bone marrow cavity, designed for simplified insertion and removal without surgical dissection or radiographic confirmation.

products.name: Endoscopic Imaging Technology (Multi-Modality Probe)
products.description: A multi-modality endoscopic imaging probe, licensed from Duke University and under development, combining angle-resolved low coherence interferometry (a/LCI) with optical coherence tomography (OCT) to enable real-time assessment and identification of esophageal precancer (dysplasia) during upper endoscopy, designed to integrate with standard endoscopic procedures.

products.name: Implantable Physiological Monitor (for Veris Cancer Care Platform)
products.description: An implantable physiological monitoring device under development, designed to be implanted alongside a vascular access port and interface with the Veris Cancer Care Platform, providing continuous remote physiologic data independent of patient compliance to enhance cancer patient monitoring.

products.name: Rezatapopt
products.description: An orally available small molecule therapy designed to selectively correct the p53 Y220C mutation in cancer cells, restoring wild-type p53 function. It is developed through synthetic chemical manufacturing and delivered as an oral precision oncology drug for patients with solid tumors harboring the p53 Y220C mutation.

products.name: Pipeline of Small Molecule Therapies Targeting p53 Mutations and p53-Related Cancers
products.description: A pipeline of orally available, potent, and highly selective small molecule product candidates developed using a proprietary precision oncology platform, targeting various p53 mutations or other p53-related cancers. These are manufactured via synthetic chemistry and intended for oral administration as targeted cancer therapies.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of a portfolio of premium-branded hotels and resorts, primarily in the luxury and upper upscale segments, located in prime U.S. markets. The company generates revenue through room rentals, meeting spaces, and related amenities, with operations managed by third-party hotel operators under management or franchise agreements.

products.name: Specialty Materials for Aerospace & Defense
products.description: Manufactured specialty materials and components, including nickel-based alloys, superalloys, titanium and titanium-based alloys, and other specialty metals, produced through advanced melting, forging, machining, and finishing processes for use in jet engines, airframes, and defense applications. Delivered as finished parts or raw materials to OEMs and suppliers.

products.name: Precision Forgings and Machined Components
products.description: Production of highly engineered precision forgings and machined parts, including disks, blades, vanes, rings, casings, shafts, and structural components, using iso-thermal and hot-die forging technologies for aerospace, defense, and industrial applications. Delivered as finished components to OEMs and tier suppliers.

products.name: Advanced Metallic Powders and Additive Manufacturing Products
products.description: Manufacture of advanced metallic powders (nickel-based, titanium-based, and specialty alloys) and 3D-printed/additively manufactured parts for aerospace and defense, leveraging powder metallurgy and laser powder bed fusion technologies. Delivered as powders or finished parts for next-generation applications.

products.name: Flat-Rolled Alloy Products (Plate, Sheet, Strip)
products.description: Production of nickel-based alloys, titanium and titanium-based alloys, stainless steel, and specialty alloys in flat-rolled forms (plate, sheet, strip), using advanced rolling and finishing processes. Supplied to aerospace, energy, electronics, automotive, and industrial markets, either directly or through service centers.

products.name: Nuclear Reactor Materials and Components
products.description: Production of reactor-grade zirconium and hafnium alloys, fuel cladding, and structural components for nuclear power generation, using proprietary alloy development and precision manufacturing. Delivered to nuclear energy customers for use in reactors and related systems.

products.name: Corrosion-Resistant Alloys for Energy and Industrial Applications
products.description: Manufacture of specialty alloys, including nickel-based, duplex, and other corrosion-resistant alloys, for use in oil & gas, chemical processing, and harsh industrial environments. Produced through advanced melting and forming processes and supplied as raw materials or components.

products.name: Medical Device Materials
products.description: Production of advanced specialty alloys, including niobium superconducting wire, biocompatible nickel-titanium (nitinol) shape memory alloy, and other specialty metals for use in medical devices such as MRI machines, prosthetics, and stents. Delivered as raw materials or semi-finished forms to medical device manufacturers.

products.name: Precision Rolled Strip (PRS) and Electronic Materials
products.description: Manufacture of precision rolled strip products and specialty alloys for electronics and communications, including computers and smartphones, using advanced rolling and finishing technologies. Delivered as strip or precursor materials to electronics manufacturers.

products.name: T Cell Engaging (TCE) Bispecific Antibody Therapeutics for Solid Tumors
products.description: A portfolio of T cell engaging bispecific antibody therapeutics, including CTIM-76 (CLDN6 x CD3 TCE), CT-95 (MSLN x CD3 TCE), and CT-202 (Nectin-4 x CD3 TCE), designed to redirect T-cell-mediated lysis toward malignant cells expressing specific tumor-associated antigens. These biologic drugs are manufactured using advanced antibody engineering and are delivered via infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Client Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management services including securities brokerage, financial planning, and access to a broad range of investment products (equities, fixed income, mutual funds, insurance, annuities) delivered through a network of financial advisors and branches. Services are provided via both commission-based and fee-based structures.

products.name: Institutional Sales, Trading, and Research
products.description: Institutional brokerage services including equity and fixed income sales and trading, market making, and proprietary research across multiple industry groups, delivered to institutional investors and supported by inventory to facilitate order flow.

products.name: Investment Banking Services
products.description: Advisory and capital markets services including mergers and acquisitions, public offerings, private placements of debt and equity, and syndicate/underwriting activities, focused on corporate and institutional clients in targeted industries.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking
products.description: Banking services for individuals and businesses, including personal and commercial lending (mortgages, home equity, unsecured loans, commercial real estate, lines of credit, credit cards), deposit products, and treasury solutions, delivered through regulated bank subsidiaries.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Investment management solutions for institutions and private clients, including managed portfolios and mutual funds, with advisory fees based on assets under management. Services are delivered through registered investment adviser subsidiaries.

products.name: Securities-Based Lending and Margin Lending
products.description: Lending services secured by client securities, including margin loans for securities purchases and securities-based loans for other purposes, subject to regulatory and internal risk controls. Delivered through both broker-dealer and bank subsidiaries.

products.name: Insurance and Annuity Products
products.description: Distribution of insurance and annuity products to clients through agreements with third-party providers, integrated into the wealth management offering and delivered by financial advisors.

products.name: Public Finance Services
products.description: Underwriting and dealer services for municipal bonds and other public finance instruments, acting as manager or participant in offerings for states, cities, and political subdivisions.

products.name: Venture Banking Services
products.description: Banking and credit solutions tailored for venture-backed and high-growth companies, including customized deposit, cash management, payment solutions, and credit facilities to support innovation and growth.

products.name: Managed IT Security Services
products.description: Ongoing management and support of client IT systems, including proactive monitoring, cybersecurity management, data backup, disaster recovery, and help desk support, delivered under subscription or contract-based models by in-person and remote IT professionals.

products.name: Secure Private Cloud Hosting
products.description: Provision of dedicated, fully isolated cloud environments for business-critical applications and data, leveraging leased Tier 3 data center infrastructure, advanced security measures, and 24/7 expert support, delivered as a managed service.

products.name: Managed Backup and Disaster Recovery
products.description: Comprehensive protection and rapid recovery solutions for customer data and IT infrastructure, utilizing automated backups, off-site replication, secure storage, and flexible recovery plans, delivered as a managed service with continuous monitoring and support.

products.name: Professional IT Services
products.description: Consulting, design, and implementation of IT solutions including cybersecurity, software planning, IT infrastructure, data center design, hybrid/cloud computing, website development, systems integration, and IT cost management, delivered by IT professionals.

products.name: Procurement Services for IT Hardware and Software
products.description: Acquisition and delivery of hardware and software products for customers, including drop-shipping from vendors or additional configuration and integration, sometimes bundled with managed services, with pricing and obligations defined by customer contracts.

products.name: Web Hosting Services
products.description: Provision of secure, managed web hosting for customer websites, including SSL/TLS encryption, DDoS protection, malware scanning, regular backups, and expert support, delivered via secure server infrastructure under contract-based terms.

products.name: ManyCam Live Streaming and Virtual Camera Software
products.description: A software product enabling professional live video streaming, virtual camera functionality, and multimedia effects for use on streaming platforms, video conferencing apps, and distance learning tools, delivered as a digital download and supported by the company.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Production and sale of gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, LPGs, and other high-value light products through complex refineries. Products are distributed via pipelines, terminals, truck, rail, and marine facilities to a wide range of customers including retailers, wholesalers, airlines, and other refiners.

products.name: Renewable Diesel
products.description: Manufacture and sale of renewable diesel from soybean oil and other renewable feedstocks at dedicated renewable diesel units (RDUs). Renewable diesel is distributed to customers in California, Oregon, Utah, and Canada, leveraging shared infrastructure with co-located refineries.

products.name: Branded Fuel Marketing
products.description: Sale of branded gasoline and diesel fuels to over 1,700 branded sites and licensing of the Sinclair brand to additional locations. Delivered through a network of retail and wholesale channels, primarily in the West and Mid-Continent regions.

products.name: Lubricants and Specialty Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of base oils, automotive, industrial and food-grade lubricants, greases, process oils, specialty fluids, white oils, petrolatums, waxes, and rubber performance products. Products are produced at facilities in Canada, the U.S., and the Netherlands and marketed globally to industrial, railroad, personal care, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and food processing industries.

products.name: Asphalt Products
products.description: Production and sale of commodity and modified asphalt products, including emulsions and specialty modified asphalts, from dedicated manufacturing facilities. Products are supplied to commercial customers for use in private, commercial, and government paving and construction projects.

products.name: Midstream Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of petroleum product and crude oil transportation, terminalling, and storage services via owned and joint-venture pipelines, terminals, and tankage. Services are provided to both internal refining operations and third-party customers, generating revenue through tariffs and fees.

products.name: Battery-Grade Natural Graphite Products
products.description: Produced through mining natural graphite at the Coosa Graphite Deposit and processing it at the Kellyton Graphite Plant using advanced purification and shaping technologies. These products are primarily used as anode active material in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage, and electronics. Production involves physical mining, mineral processing, and proprietary chemical purification.

products.name: ULTRA-CSPG™
products.description: A high-purity, spheroidized, and surface-coated graphite product manufactured at the Kellyton Graphite Plant, designed specifically for use as anode material in lithium-ion batteries. Production involves micronization, spheroidization, purification, and carbon coating processes.

products.name: SG Fines
products.description: A byproduct of the spheroidization process at the Kellyton Graphite Plant, SG Fines are fine graphite particles suitable for various industrial and battery-related applications. Produced alongside ULTRA-CSPG™ during graphite processing.

products.name: Natural Graphite Flake Concentrate
products.description: Concentrated graphite flake produced from mined ore at the Coosa Graphite Deposit using flotation and milling. This concentrate serves as feedstock for further processing into battery-grade products or can be sold to third-party consumers.

products.name: Potential Vanadium Products
products.description: Future potential extraction and processing of vanadium from the Coosa Graphite Deposit for use in specialty steels, titanium alloys, and vanadium redox flow batteries. Not currently in production or included in economic models, but represents long-term optionality.

products.name: Postal Property Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of real estate properties, primarily post offices and industrial facilities, to the USPS under modified double-net leases. This involves acquiring, managing, and maintaining a large portfolio of postal properties across the United States, with physical assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Postal Property Management Services
products.description: Management of postal properties owned by third parties, including properties owned by the company's CEO and affiliates, through a taxable REIT subsidiary. This service involves operational oversight and property management for external owners.

products.name: General Aviation Aircraft
products.description: Manufacture and sale of business jets, turboprop aircraft, military trainer and defense aircraft, and piston engine aircraft under the Cessna and Beechcraft brands. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers worldwide, requiring regulated infrastructure and certification.

products.name: Aviation Aftermarket Parts and Services
products.description: Provision of commercial parts sales, maintenance, inspection and repair services, and advanced flight training devices for Textron Aviation aircraft. Delivered through a global network of service centers and mobile support units, requiring in-person labor and regulated facilities.

products.name: Military and Commercial Helicopters and Tiltrotor Aircraft
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of military and commercial helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft, including related spare parts and support services, under the Bell brand. Products are physically manufactured and delivered globally, requiring advanced engineering and regulatory certification.

products.name: Helicopter Aftermarket Parts, Support, and Training Services
products.description: Provision of post-sale support, maintenance, parts, logistics, pilot and maintenance training, and technical support for Bell helicopters. Delivered through a global network of service centers and training academies, requiring in-person labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Defense Systems and Unmanned Aircraft
products.description: Development, manufacture, and integration of defense products including unmanned aircraft systems, armored and specialty vehicles, advanced marine craft, electronic systems, and weapons for military and government customers. Products are physically manufactured and often require integration with customer missions and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Military Training and Support Services
products.description: Provision of live military air-to-air and air-to-ship training and support services, including fee-for-service programs using manned and unmanned aircraft, primarily for U.S. and allied military personnel. Delivered through specialized service operations and requires in-person labor and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Automotive Fuel and Emission Systems
products.description: Design and manufacture of plastic fuel systems, pressurized tanks for hybrid vehicles, selective catalytic reduction tanks, and other fuel system components for automotive OEMs. Products are physically manufactured in global plants and delivered to automotive manufacturers.

products.name: Automotive Vision and Cleaning Systems
products.description: Development and manufacture of clear-vision systems and cleaning systems for automotive safety and ADAS, including nozzles, reservoirs, inlets, and pumps. Products are manufactured and supplied to automotive OEMs.

products.name: Automotive Battery Systems
products.description: Manufacture of lightweight, composite battery systems for electric vehicles, including enclosures, underbody protection, and thermal management systems. Products are manufactured and supplied to automotive OEMs.

products.name: Golf Cars and Light Transportation Vehicles
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of golf cars, utility vehicles, and light transportation vehicles under various brands. Products are physically manufactured and sold to golf courses, resorts, municipalities, and consumers worldwide.

products.name: Aviation Ground Support Equipment
products.description: Manufacture and sale of aviation ground support equipment for airports and airlines, including products under multiple brands. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to commercial and industrial users.

products.name: Professional Turf and Turf-Care Equipment
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of professional turf-maintenance equipment and specialized turf-care vehicles for golf courses, landscaping professionals, and sporting venues. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Light Aircraft and Gliders (including Electric Aircraft)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of light aircraft and gliders, including electric and combustion engine models, under the Pipistrel brand. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers, with some models certified for flight training.

products.name: Commercial Finance Services for Aircraft and Helicopters
products.description: Provision of financing services primarily to purchasers of new and pre-owned Textron Aviation aircraft and Bell helicopters, including cross-border transactions. Services are delivered through Textron Financial Corporation and its subsidiaries, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Smart Eyewear
products.description: Smart eyewear products that integrate Bluetooth audio, voice assistant access, and hands-free smartphone functionality into prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, safety glasses, and sport glasses. These are physically manufactured frames with embedded electronics, available in multiple styles and lens options, and sold through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Smart Eyewear Software Applications
products.description: Mobile applications (Lucyd app for iOS and Android) that provide enhanced features for smart eyewear, including AI assistant integration (ChatGPT), walkie-talkie communication, translation, and other voice-driven functionalities. Delivered digitally and updated over time, with a free and a paid Pro version.

products.name: Retail Display Systems and Kiosks
products.description: Physical point-of-sale display materials, including virtual try-on kiosks, modular display units, and interactive LCD fixtures, provided to retail partners to support in-store product education and demonstrations. These are manufactured and customized for retail environments.

products.name: Medicare-Centric Value-Based Care Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of healthcare for Medicare Advantage and Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries through risk-bearing entities and global capitation arrangements with payors. Delivered via partnerships with community-based physician groups, leveraging proprietary technology, processes, and capital to support a Total Care Model focused on quality and cost outcomes. Services include managing all Part A and B costs, and in some cases, Part D pharmaceutical costs.

products.name: Accountable Care Organization (ACO) Participation Services
products.description: Participation in CMS ACO Models (ACO REACH and MSSP) through approved ACOs, partnering with physician groups to manage care for Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries. agilon assumes accountability for total cost of care and shares in savings or losses, supporting physician partners with operational, financial, and incentive structures under CMS contracts.

products.name: Live TV Streaming Service
products.description: A subscription-based, sports-first live TV streaming platform offering access to live sports, news, and entertainment channels, delivered digitally via streaming devices, Smart TVs, mobile phones, tablets, and computers. The service is built on proprietary technology designed for live TV and sports viewership, requiring sophisticated infrastructure for regularly refreshing live programming.

products.name: Advertising Services on Streaming Platform
products.description: Digital advertising inventory sold to brands and agencies, integrated into the live TV streaming platform, leveraging first-party data and innovative ad formats to deliver targeted, unskippable ads to a highly engaged audience. Delivered digitally and optimized through proprietary analytics and technology.

products.name: Premium Channel and Feature Attachments
products.description: Optional add-on packages and features for subscribers, including premium channels, channel packages, and enhanced functionalities such as Cloud DVR Plus and Family Share, delivered digitally as incremental upgrades to the core streaming service.

products.name: Bempikibart (ADX-914)
products.description: A fully human anti–interleukin-7 receptor alpha (IL-7Rα) antagonist monoclonal antibody biologic, developed and delivered via subcutaneous injection, intended to restore immune balance in patients with alopecia areata and other autoimmune/inflammatory diseases. Manufactured through biotechnological processes and requires clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Tissue-Targeted Complement Inhibitor Platform (including ADX-096 and related assets)
products.description: A proprietary platform of biologic therapeutics designed to inhibit complement activation locally in tissues, minimizing systemic effects. Includes assets such as ADX-096 (C3d mAb–CR11-10 fusion protein) and other C3d mAb fusions and nanobodies, intended for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. These are manufactured using biotechnological methods and are in preclinical or early clinical development.

products.name: VYJUVEK (B-VEC) for Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB)
products.description: A redosable, off-the-shelf topical gene therapy delivering two copies of the COL7A1 gene to skin cells, manufactured using proprietary HSV-1 vector technology and administered by healthcare professionals, caregivers, or patients at home or in a clinical setting.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Respiratory Diseases (KB407 for Cystic Fibrosis, KB408 for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency)
products.description: Redosable, off-the-shelf gene therapies delivered via inhaled (nebulized) administration, using HSV-1 vectors to deliver therapeutic transgenes (CFTR for cystic fibrosis, SERPINA1 for AATD) directly to airway epithelia, manufactured in-house under CGMP conditions.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Ophthalmic Diseases (KB803 for Ocular DEB, KB801 for Neurotrophic Keratitis)
products.description: Redosable gene therapies formulated as eye drops, using HSV-1 vectors to deliver therapeutic transgenes (COL7A1 for ocular DEB, NGF for neurotrophic keratitis) to the corneal epithelium, enabling local, sustained protein expression for disease modification.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Rare Dermatologic Diseases (KB111 for Hailey-Hailey Disease)
products.description: A topical gel gene therapy using HSV-1 vectors to deliver the ATP2C1 transgene to skin cells, aiming to accelerate lesion healing and reduce disease burden in Hailey-Hailey Disease, produced via proprietary manufacturing processes.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Oncology (KB707 for Solid Tumors)
products.description: Redosable immunotherapy using HSV-1 vectors to deliver genes encoding IL-2 and IL-12 to the tumor microenvironment, with formulations for both inhaled (lung delivery) and transcutaneous injection, aiming to promote systemic immune-mediated tumor clearance in solid tumors including NSCLC.

products.name: Gene Therapies for Aesthetic Skin Conditions (KB304, KB301, and pipeline)
products.description: Gene therapies delivered via intradermal injection, using HSV-1 vectors to deliver cosmetic protein transgenes (e.g., COL3A1, ELN) to stimulate biorejuvenation, improve skin attributes such as wrinkles, elasticity, and radiance, targeting areas like the décolleté and face.

products.name: Garment Manufacturing
products.description: Manufacture of garments for wholesalers and retailers, primarily through owned production facilities in Guangdong, China, involving in-house design, fabric sourcing, and quality control processes. Products are delivered to customers using in-house or outsourced logistics.

products.name: Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of comprehensive logistics services including delivery, courier, storage, transportation, warehousing, handling, packaging, order processing, customs declaration, and tax clearance, covering 45 cities in 10 provinces and 2 municipalities in China, with some services outsourced to contractors.

products.name: Property Management and Subleasing
products.description: Provision of shop subleasing and property management services, including security, maintenance, and customer support, for garment wholesalers and retailers in the garment market, managing over 56,000 square meters of floor space and approximately 1,300 shop spaces.

products.name: Alternative Investment Management Services
products.description: Provision of investment management services in alternative asset classes, including private markets (such as private equity and other private market strategies) and liquid alternatives (such as multi-strategy, global macro, relative value fixed income, and trend-following). Delivered through specialized investment processes by independent Affiliates, often via pooled funds or separate accounts, and requires significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Long-Only Investment Management Services
products.description: Provision of differentiated long-only investment management services, including equities, multi-asset, and fixed income strategies. Delivered through mutual funds, ETFs, separately managed accounts, and UCITS, requiring regulated infrastructure and investment expertise, and offered to both institutional and individual clients globally.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provision of investment management, customized investment counseling, and fiduciary services to high net worth individuals, families, and institutional clients. Delivered by specialized Affiliates through multi-asset class portfolios, requiring in-person advisory expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Open-Air Shopping Center Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail space in high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties, primarily located in major metropolitan Sun Belt and coastal markets. This involves physical real estate ownership, property management, and tenant leasing activities.

products.name: Mixed-Use Property Leasing and Development
products.description: Development, ownership, and leasing of mixed-use properties that combine retail, residential, and office components, including live/work/play environments. This requires real estate development, construction, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Real Estate Management Services
products.description: Provision of property management, leasing, and operational support services for real estate assets owned by institutional investors and other third parties, often through joint ventures. Delivered via in-person management and administrative expertise.

products.name: Structured Real Estate Investments and Financing
products.description: Provision of preferred equity capital, real estate capital, and retail real estate financing to real estate professionals and retailers, including both healthy and distressed entities. Involves financial capital deployment and investment management.

products.name: Net Lease Property Investments
products.description: Ownership and leasing of net lease properties, where tenants are responsible for most property expenses. This involves acquiring and managing a portfolio of net leased assets, often through joint ventures.

products.name: Homebuilding (Single-Family Detached and Attached Homes)
products.description: Designs, constructs, and sells single-family detached and attached homes (including townhomes and duplexes) primarily for entry-level, first, second, and third move-up buyers, as well as limited custom builds. Homes are built using in-house plans, with options for personalization and upgrades, and are delivered through a production building process in high-growth Southeastern U.S. markets.

products.name: Build-to-Rent (BTR) Home Construction
products.description: Constructs homes specifically for institutional owners of residential rental properties, leveraging existing home designs suited for rental demand. Delivery is through production building, often in partnership with institutional investors seeking newly constructed rental homes.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides mortgage origination and brokerage services to homebuyers through a joint venture (Homeowners Mortgage, LLC), arranging financing for home purchases. Services are delivered digitally and in-person, leveraging partnerships with national lenders and compliance with federal and state regulations.

products.name: Power Discrete Semiconductors (MOSFETs and IGBTs)
products.description: Manufactured and supplied low, medium, and high voltage power MOSFETs and IGBTs, used for switching, transferring, and converting electricity in electronic systems. These are produced using proprietary silicon and packaging technologies in both in-house and third-party facilities, and delivered as discrete components for integration into end products.

products.name: Power ICs (Integrated Circuits for Power Management)
products.description: Designed, developed, and supplied integrated circuits that deliver, control, and regulate power management variables such as voltage and current. These ICs are manufactured using proprietary multi-chip and packaging technologies, and are delivered as integrated solutions for power management in electronic devices.

products.name: Silicon Carbide (SiC) Power Devices
products.description: Developed and supplied SiC-based power semiconductor devices, including MOSFETs, for high efficiency and high density industrial and automotive applications. These are manufactured using proprietary SiC technology platforms and delivered as discrete or module products.

products.name: Smart Power Modules and Motor Control Modules
products.description: Designed and supplied integrated smart motor modules and power modules, combining power semiconductors and control circuitry in compact packages for motor drive and industrial applications. These are manufactured using advanced packaging and integration techniques.

products.name: Analog Power Devices for Circuit Protection and Signal Switching
products.description: Supplied analog power devices such as transient voltage protection, analog switches, and electromagnetic interference filters, manufactured using proprietary analog semiconductor processes and delivered as discrete components for protection and switching in electronic circuits.

products.name: Aircraft Engine Maintenance, Repair, and Exchange Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance, repair, rebuilding, and exchange services for CFM56-5B, CFM56-7B, and V2500 aircraft engines through proprietary facilities and joint ventures. Services are delivered via physical maintenance operations and exchange programs.

products.name: Aircraft Engine and Aftermarket Component Sales
products.description: Development, manufacture, refurbishment, and sale of aircraft engines, modules, and aftermarket parts, primarily for CFM56-7B, CFM56-5B, and V2500 engines. Products are produced through manufacturing and refurbishment in dedicated facilities and sold to global customers.

products.name: Aviation Asset Leasing (Aircraft and Engines)
products.description: Leasing of commercial aircraft and aircraft engines to airlines and other operators worldwide. Assets are owned or managed and leased under long-term contracts, requiring capital investment and asset management expertise.

products.name: Aviation Asset Management Services
products.description: Provision of asset management services for aviation assets, including managing third-party capital to invest in and oversee on-lease aircraft and engines. Services include operational oversight, lease management, and strategic asset allocation for institutional investors.

products.name: Aircraft Engine Teardown and Parts Sales
products.description: Teardown of used aircraft engines and sale of serviceable modules and parts through exclusive partnerships. This involves physical disassembly, repair, and marketing of engine components for resale.

products.name: Engine Conversion to Power Turbines
products.description: Conversion of CFM56 aircraft engines to power turbines for non-aviation applications, delivered through the FTAI Power platform. This involves engineering modifications and repurposing of aviation engines for industrial use.

products.name: RASP Modulator Therapies
products.description: Small molecule pharmaceuticals that modulate reactive aldehyde species (RASP) for the treatment of immune-mediated diseases, delivered via topical ocular, oral, or intravitreal administration. These are developed through chemical synthesis and require clinical and regulatory development.

products.name: Intravitreal Methotrexate Formulation (ADX-2191)
products.description: A novel intravitreal formulation of methotrexate, specifically designed for injection into the eye to treat retinal diseases such as primary vitreoretinal lymphoma and retinitis pigmentosa. Manufactured as a concentrated, vitreous-compatible injectable drug product.

products.name: Home Medical Equipment and Supplies
products.description: Comprehensive range of home medical equipment and disposable medical supplies, including ostomy, wound care, urology, incontinence, and other products, delivered directly to patients and home health agencies. Products are physically manufactured or sourced, stored, and distributed through regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Diabetes Treatment Products and Services
products.description: Provision of products and services for in-home diabetes care, including medical devices and supplies, delivered to patients' homes and supported by clinical and administrative services. Requires regulated distribution and clinical support.

products.name: Home Respiratory Therapy Services
products.description: Home-based respiratory therapy services, including provision and rental of home oxygen and non-invasive ventilation equipment, with associated patient support. Involves regulated medical equipment, clinical labor, and in-home delivery.

products.name: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Treatment Solutions
products.description: Provision of devices and services for obstructive sleep apnea treatment, including CPAP and bi-level positive airway pressure devices, with patient support services. Delivered to patients' homes and supported by clinical staff.

products.name: Integrated Home Healthcare Services
products.description: Integrated home healthcare services, including clinical and administrative support, care plan management, and coordination with providers and payors. Delivered by licensed professionals and supported by digital and in-person processes.

products.name: Vacation Ownership (Timeshare) Products
products.description: Sale of vacation ownership interests (VOIs) through a points-based or interval system, allowing customers to share ownership of fully-furnished vacation accommodations at over 280 resorts under multiple brands. This involves physical real estate development, sales, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Vacation Exchange Services
products.description: Membership-based vacation exchange programs (primarily through RCI) that allow members to exchange their owned vacation intervals or points for stays at affiliated resorts worldwide. Delivered digitally and via call centers, leveraging a network of 3,600 affiliated resorts.

products.name: Travel Club Services
products.description: Closed-user group travel clubs offering members access to curated travel products and services, including accommodations, flights, car rentals, and exclusive deals, delivered primarily through proprietary websites and call centers. Includes B2B private-label solutions for organizations and affinity groups.

products.name: Consumer Financing for Vacation Ownership
products.description: Provision of consumer loans to finance the purchase of vacation ownership interests, including loan origination, servicing, and securitization. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance, managed through a wholly-owned financing subsidiary.

products.name: Property Management Services for Vacation Ownership Resorts
products.description: Management of day-to-day operations for vacation ownership resorts on behalf of property owners’ associations, including housekeeping, maintenance, refurbishment, and administrative services. Delivered through in-person labor and regulated property management agreements.

products.name: International Life Insurance and Endowment Products
products.description: U.S. dollar-denominated individual whole life insurance and endowment products with living benefit features, primarily sold to non-U.S. residents in over 80 countries. These products are manufactured and administered by the company and distributed through independent marketing agencies and consultants.

products.name: Domestic Final Expense Life Insurance
products.description: Simplified issue whole life insurance policies with small face amounts, primarily intended to cover funeral and burial costs, sold to individuals in the United States through independent agents and funeral homes. These products are manufactured and administered by the company and distributed via a network of agents and brokers.

products.name: Domestic Critical Illness Insurance
products.description: Critical illness insurance policies, primarily issued to lower-income individuals in select U.S. states, providing lump-sum benefits upon diagnosis of specified illnesses. These are distributed through independent agents and brokers.

products.name: LB-100 Series Anti-Cancer Therapeutics
products.description: A proprietary series of small molecule inhibitors of protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A), developed through chemical synthesis and preclinical/clinical research, intended to be administered as anti-cancer drugs alone or in combination with other therapies. These are manufactured via pharmaceutical processes and delivered as regulated, investigational or approved drugs for cancer treatment.

products.name: LB-100 Combination Cancer Therapies
products.description: Combination therapies using LB-100 with other anti-cancer agents (such as immune checkpoint inhibitors, doxorubicin, or other investigational compounds), developed and delivered as co-administered pharmaceutical regimens for enhanced cancer treatment efficacy. These are subject to clinical trials and regulatory approval, and involve pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical delivery.

products.name: LB-100 Prodrugs and Analogs
products.description: Pharmaceutical compositions and formulations of LB-100 prodrugs and analogs, developed through chemical modification of the LB-100 molecule, intended for use as anti-cancer therapeutics. These are manufactured and delivered as regulated drugs, pending further clinical development and approval.

products.name: LiGHT Proton Therapy System (Prototype and IP Licensing)
products.description: A proprietary, modular linear accelerator system (LiGHT) for proton beam cancer therapy, developed and manufactured as a physical prototype with associated intellectual property. The system is not marketed as a turnkey clinical device but is positioned for sale or licensing as a functional prototype and IP asset to organizations seeking to develop or replicate advanced proton therapy centers.

products.name: Water Supply Services
products.description: Provision of conserved groundwater from the Cadiz aquifer system to public and private water systems, government agencies, and commercial businesses, delivered via pipeline infrastructure. Water is extracted, monitored, and sold under long-term contracts, requiring physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Water Storage and Banking Services
products.description: Provision of underground water storage ('banking') capacity in the Mojave Groundwater Bank, allowing customers to store imported or surplus water in the aquifer system for future use. This service requires physical infrastructure, regulatory approvals, and ongoing maintenance.

products.name: Water Conveyance Services
products.description: Operation and development of long-range water pipelines (Northern and Southern Pipelines) to transport water supplies for customers, including public water systems and commercial users. This involves conversion and construction of large-scale pipeline infrastructure and related facilities.

products.name: Water Filtration Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of modular water filtration systems (via ATEC Water Systems) for removal of contaminants from groundwater, serving municipalities, utilities, industries, and engineering firms. These are physical products requiring manufacturing, engineering, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Agricultural Products
products.description: Cultivation and sale of grain crops (primarily alfalfa) grown on the Cadiz Ranch, using groundwater for irrigation. Farming is conducted directly or via leases to third-party operators, requiring land, water, and agricultural labor.

products.name: Land Leasing for Renewable Energy Development
products.description: Leasing of land at the Cadiz Ranch for the development of renewable energy projects, such as a solar-powered green hydrogen production facility. This involves long-term land leases and potential water sales to energy developers.

products.name: Habitat Conservation Bank Credits
products.description: Sale of conservation credits from the Fenner Valley Desert Tortoise Conservation Bank, supporting permanent preservation of sensitive habitat. This involves land management and regulatory compliance for environmental mitigation.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: The Trust owns and collects income from royalty and mineral interests in producing and proved undeveloped oil and gas properties. These interests entitle the Trust to a share of production revenues from oil and natural gas extracted by third-party operators, without the Trust itself engaging in exploration, production, or operations. Income is distributed to unit holders after deduction of administrative expenses.

firms.firm: BANK OF THE JAMES FINANCIAL GROUP INC

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive banking services including deposit accounts (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, IRAs, HSAs), lending (commercial, consumer, real estate, construction, mortgage), and related transaction services, delivered through physical branches and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure, financial capital, and in-person and digital service delivery.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination and sale of conforming and non-conforming residential mortgage loans, including fixed and floating-rate mortgages and construction loans, primarily funded by the Bank and sold to correspondent financial institutions. Delivered through dedicated mortgage offices and requires regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Investment Advisory (Wealth Management) Services
products.description: Provision of investment advisory and wealth management services to clients, including portfolio management and financial planning, delivered by a registered investment adviser subsidiary. Requires licensed professionals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Securities Brokerage Services
products.description: Securities brokerage services for customers, including buying and selling securities through a third-party broker-dealer partnership. Delivered via in-person and remote channels, requiring regulatory compliance but not principal trading by the bank.

products.name: Insurance and Annuity Products
products.description: Acting as an agent to offer life insurance, fixed annuities, and disability insurance products from national insurance companies to customers. Requires licensed agents and regulatory compliance, but the bank does not underwrite risk.
